summary: Gone fire tower at Muscatatuck State Park, now Muscatatuck County Park. Built in the 1930s by WPA and CCC; 1935 and 1938 newspaper items; no removal date found.

facts.agency: State Department of Conservation (named in a 1935 plan)
facts.status_note: Not standing, per two lookout lists

access.note: Muscatatuck County Park, returned to Jennings County for recreational uses in 1968; no tower stands

events.note: Jackson County Banner item (February 20, 1935): a fire tower would be erected in Jennings County by the State Department of Conservation. Plan, not confirmed build.
Indiana Fire Towers reads a 1936 county map, which shows the park but no tower, as a sign the tower did not yet exist. An inference from absence.
Brown County Democrat item (April 7, 1938): two enrollees on detached service helping erect a fire tower at the park.

evidence.supports: Park opened 1921 as Indiana's fourth state park
evidence.quote: Opened 1921 as Indiana's fourth state park for its natural beauty and recreation potential.

evidence.supports: Fire tower built by WPA and CCC in the 1930s
evidence.quote: Stone shelters and stairways, fire tower, trails, and retaining walls were built by Works Progress Administration and Civilian Conservation Corps in 1930s.

evidence.supports: Park returned to Jennings County in 1968 for recreation
evidence.quote: In 1968, park was returned to Jennings County for recreational uses.

evidence.supports: 1935 plan for a fire tower by the State Department of Conservation
evidence.quote: A fire tower will be erected in Jennings county by the State Department of Conservation.
Enrollees W.M. (Ohio) Smith and Eros are on detached service helping erect a fire tower at Muscatatuck State Park.

evidence.supports: 1936 county map shows no tower at the park
evidence.quote: The 1936 cultural Map of Jennings County shows a State Park between Vernon and North Vernon, but does not show a fire tower there; this suggests that the tower did not exist in 1936.

evidence.supports: Forest Service list notes the tower location is unresolved
evidence.quote: Jennings Muscatatuck Tower (trying to determine location?)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The marker's 1930s construction, the 1938 erection report and the 1936 map inference are read together as building in the mid-1930s. None of the sources gives a completion date, so the build year stays open.

sources.title: Lookout Towers
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Hoosier National Forest

notes_for_editor: Build date is open: the marker says 1930s WPA and CCC work, a 1935 plan and an April 1938 erection item exist, and the Indiana Fire Towers 1936 map point is an inference from absence. No removal date or reason was found. The Indiana Fire Towers site cites a YouTube video showing a tower at 6:45; not checked. The Forest Service list still marks the location as unresolved. Record agency was null; facts.agency takes the 1935 plan agency and is not a confirmed builder. Coordinates match across FFLA and Indiana Fire Towers.
